$comment: [X2.2] Azure MCP attach spec. Tier-1 first-party-ms. Shape === mcp-specs/_template.json (X2.1). Validated by spec-fields.checkSpecShape + (X2.8) mcp-spec-v1.schema.json. CC0-1.0.
title: Azure Resource Management
description: Microsoft Azure resource lifecycle, monitoring, cost, and data-plane operations via the official Azure MCP server.

env_vars.name: AZURE_TENANT_ID
env_vars.description: Entra tenant (directory) ID. Required only for the service-principal auth path; omit when using `az login`.

env_vars.name: AZURE_CLIENT_ID
env_vars.description: App registration (service principal) client ID. Required only for the service-principal auth path.

env_vars.name: AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
env_vars.description: Service-principal client secret. Required only for the service-principal auth path; pass via env, never inline in args (doctrine #6).

env_vars.name: AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID
env_vars.description: Default subscription scope. Optional; tools accept an explicit subscription argument when unset.

auth.recipe: managed identity / `az login` preferred for local dev; service-principal env vars (AZURE_TENANT_ID + AZURE_CLIENT_ID + AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET) for CI.

sample_tools.name: subscription
sample_tools.summary: List and inspect Azure subscriptions in scope.

sample_tools.name: monitor
sample_tools.summary: Query Azure Monitor logs and metrics.

sample_tools.name: storage
sample_tools.summary: Inspect storage accounts, blobs, and queues.

sample_tools.name: keyvault
sample_tools.summary: List Key Vault secrets, keys, and certificates (metadata).

known_limitations: Requires an authenticated Azure context (`az login` or service-principal env vars); without it tools return an auth error rather than an empty list.
Tool surface is large and subscription-scoped — many tools require an explicit subscription or resource-group argument.
Destructive-action audit (X2.18): resource/group deletion tools are flagged in `destructive_tools` and are blocked when the trust policy sets `allowDestructive: false`.

client_install.claude_desktop: Add to claude_desktop_config.json mcpServers as `azure`: { command: npx, args: [-y, @azure/mcp, server, start] }; run `az login` first.
client_install.cursor: Settings → MCP → Add: name `azure`, command `npx -y @azure/mcp server start`.
client_install.vscode: Add to .vscode/mcp.json servers as `azure` (VS Code Insider, MCP preview).
